## 6. Deposit-linked Insurance Scheme  
1. When a GPF / CPF subscriber dies after having put in five years service, the person receiving the Fund balance will be paid an additional amount if the balance at credit had not fallen below the undermentioned limits at any time during the 3 years preceding the month of death:  
| GPF (VI Pay Commission Scale) | GPF (VI Pay Commission Scale) | CPF (IV Pay Commission Scale) | CPF (IV Pay Commission Scale) |
